findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (52.33 yds from volume vs 47.66 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.56 per player (projected 31.16, actual 31.72).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.05 (projected 7.17, actual 7.13).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66.26, without it 65.11. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 40/114 (35.09%). Our MAE 65.22 vs the line's 58.62. The book is the better projection.
